method: Recomputed full RDS MD5 checksums and compared every exported cell, marker value, label, and coordinate directly with the source SingleCellExperiment objects. Independently checked Zenodo license/creator metadata and scanned every locally converted region to verify the selection rule. For s240, compared all exported fields with the local CSVs, checked annotation-version selection, and verified membership in the saved patient split.
numeric_tolerance: For each value, abs(exported - source) / max(1, abs(source)) < 1e-12. Observed errors are below 5.1e-15 for intensities and below 4.8e-15 for doubled coordinates, consistent with CSV serialization precision.
coordinate_scale_limit: The factor-of-two coordinate conversion was verified numerically for both datasets. Damond reports approximately 1 micrometre acquisition resolution; Meyer physical calibration has not been independently verified against acquisition metadata. The tutorial uses the local converter setting of 1 micrometre per native unit.
training_scope_check: The project crosswalk categorizes both collections as external. Neither selected region name appears in the recorded training/validation split. This is not an independent audit of patient or source-image overlap across differently named datasets. The added s240 region belongs to the internal training partition, not internal validation. Internal/external here refers to SOBER development, not whether a source study is publicly available.

internal_csv_check.limitation: Verified against the supplied local tables and recorded split, not against acquisition-level raw images or an independent public data deposit. Physical coordinate calibration and redistribution license are not established by these CSVs.
